name: Is it possible to add insulation to walls without tearing down drywall?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to add insulation to walls without tearing down drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is often possible to add insulation to existing walls without removing drywall, especially for homes that were built without sufficient insulation. This process typically involves drilling small, strategically placed holes from the exterior or interior of the home. Blown-in insulation, such as cellulose or fiberglass, is then dense-packed into the wall cavities through these holes. Once filled, the holes are sealed and repaired, minimizing disruption to your home's interior finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, blown-in insulation can be installed by drilling small holes in walls from the exterior or interior, avoiding the need to remove drywall.
